content.answer_markdown: The Assistant requires an LLM Exchange to be selected because the detailed content of an LLM Exchange—such as the system text, prompt, and reply—is only available when a specific Exchange is chosen. Without selecting one, the Assistant has no data from the current screen context to analyze or discuss regarding any LLM Exchange.

citations.figure: No LLM Exchange is selected, so none is included. Open one to ask about it.

claims.text: The Assistant needs a selected LLM Exchange to access its system text, prompt, and reply for discussion.

follow_up_questions: How can I select an LLM Exchange on this screen?
What information does an LLM Exchange contain?
Can I view past LLM Exchanges for audit purposes?
